text: PBOC conducted a securities, fund and insurance company swap facility operation totalling RMB100bn via fee-rate tender. 31 firms participated; clearing rate was 10bp. China International Capital Co was allotted RMB16.3bn. On Nov 4 it completed the first pledged repo under this op
text_zh: 中国人民银行通过费率招标开展了总额1000亿元人民币的证券、基金、保险公司互换便利操作。31家机构参与，清算费率为10bp。中国国际金融股份有限公司获配163亿元人民币。11月4日，其完成了该操作下的首笔质押式回购
